sn35.159:1.1: rūpe bhikkhave yoniso manasikarotha rūpāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha.
sn35.159:1.2: rūpe bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto rūpāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto rūpesu nibbindati
sn35.159:1.10: dhamme bhikkhave yoniso manasikarotha dhammāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha
sn35.159:1.11: dhamme bhikkhave bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto dhammāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto dhammesu nibbindati
